caption:
In the Costa Rican highlands, mountain roads rarely contour around ridges—they climb straight up them. This means mountain biking in Costa Rica often asks for a different kind of patience, where the grade occasionally forces you off the saddle to walk alongside your bike, listening to the quiet hum of the cloud forest. It is not a defeat; it is simply the pace the terrain demands. Up here, where the damp grass meets the gravel, the air is thin, cool, and smells of wet earth. You are not racing the clock; you are adjusting to the rhythm of the mountain.
